title: Kafka Schema Mismatch Experiment - Booking Details
description: On book hotel POST API, first booking information is stored in booking-info table. Then the booking information is put in Kafka topic in booking-service. Currently supported Kafka schema version is V1. But producer puts V2 schema msg in the booking-events topic. So the kafka consumer in booking-post-processing-service rejects the message. Rejected msg gets added in booking-events-dlq topic. Since the message is rejected, booking details does not get stored in booking-details table which leads to 5xx error on GetBookingDetails GET API
